mentions.name: PonderCode
mentions.description: A harness for personal use that applies sandboxing ideas similar to Adamant, but is built for text-heavy work instead of TUIs, addressing the copy-paste difficulties caused by space-padded output.
mentions.problem: TUIs are irritating for text-heavy work, and copy-pasting is a nightmare as almost everything is space-padded.
mentions.source_excerpt: Building an actual harness called PonderCode for personal use that uses ideas similar to Adamant as I find TUIs irritating for the text heavy work I do. Copy-pasting is a nightmare as almost everything is space-padded.
